# series occurrence

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/seriesOccurrence>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an event series to one of the concrete event occurrences it issues.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) -> [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) from [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) to [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md), [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) to a concrete [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) occurrence it issued — the series-rooted direction of the planned/actual relation.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it when [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md) reads more naturally (the occurrence-rooted inverse), and avoid using it to carry the recurrence rule (that is [`gmeow:hasRecurrenceRule`](gmeow-hasRecurrenceRule.md)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) from the series to each issued event, or its inverse [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md) from the event; one direction suffices.

- ex:standup [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) ex:standup20240603.
